CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

2. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.

6. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)

   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

9. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

10. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)

11. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

12. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
